title: Seating plan
loadFailed: Could not load the plan. Try again.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
conflictHelp: Writes are paused. Reload the current plan before continuing; your change did not silently overwrite someone else's.
reloadRequired: The save outcome is unconfirmed. Reload before continuing.
geometry: The entire rotated table must stay inside the room. The change was reverted; move the table or enlarge the room.
name: Name
templateHelp: A template copies its own room dimensions and tables. Entered dimensions apply to a blank plan.
sourceHelp: Confirmed guests appear in the unassigned list when opening or refreshing the plan. Saved seats and explicit removals are preserved.
rsvpNoInvitation: This project has no invitation yet. You can add guests manually through Add guest.
rsvpSetupRequired: Automatic attendance tracking needs the final SQL model setup. Manual guest addition and seating remain available.
rsvpGuestsAdded: Guests added to the unassigned list ({count}).
selectTable: Select a table on the canvas or in the list.
capacityHelp: Capacity does not change table dimensions. Occupied chairs cannot be removed and capacity cannot fall below the guest count.
newPersonHelp: Choose a person from this project or add a new one without an invitation. The person will be included in this plan.
notLinked: Not linked to the selected invitation
deleteHelp: Remove “{name}”? The project person is preserved. Deleting a table removes its assignments; removing a participant removes their assignment; deleting a plan removes its layout.
canvasHelp: Drag the background to pan · Space or Hand only move the view · Pinch to zoom
capacityError: The table is full or the new capacity is below its occupancy.
archivedError: Archived people cannot be included or assigned.
plansHelp: Open an existing layout or create a new one for this project.
createPlanHelp: Choose an empty room or an active template. Resize the room on the canvas; edit the name and RSVP source in plan settings.
directEditHelp: Drag the table to move it. Use the handle above it to rotate. Table dimensions are standard.
dragGuest: Drag {name} or tap to choose a seat
rsvpConflictHelp: This guest has conflicting RSVP answers. Check their answers in the invitation before assigning a place.
absentAssignedHelp: This guest declined, but their place remains reserved. Remove them from the table to free the chair.
guestDragHelp: Drag a guest using the grip next to their name and drop them on a table, then choose a chair. On desktop, dropping onto a free chair saves the assignment immediately.
personCreatedNotIncluded: The person was created. Inclusion in the plan is unconfirmed. After resolving the error, include the same person; they will not be created again.
dropMiss: The guest was not assigned. Drop onto a chair or table, or use the seat picker beside their name.
tableStandardsHelp: Round tables: Ø {diameter} cm. Rectangular: depth {height} cm and initial length {width} cm for 8 seats; length follows the seat count. Use these controls to standardize existing tables.
standardizeHelp: Standardize {count} tables to {width} × {height} cm? Names, positions, rotations, seat counts and guest assignments are preserved.
standardizeGeometry: A standard table at its current position would extend outside the room. Move tables away from the edges or enlarge the room before trying again.
standardizePartial: Standardizing was not completed. Some changes may have been saved. Reload the plan before continuing.
longTableCapacityHelp: More seats extend the table; depth stays the same. Each end has at most two chairs. Release occupied seat numbers before reducing capacity.
longTableNoSpace: The extended table does not fit in the room. Move it away from the edge or enlarge the room; the previous seat count and dimensions are preserved.
standardizeLongHelp: Standardize {count} rectangular tables to depth {height} cm and lengths {minWidth}–{maxWidth} cm based on their seat counts? Names, positions, rotations, seat counts and guest assignments are preserved.
createTableHelp: Choose the shape, name and number of seats. Check the preview, then add the table to your layout.
roundTableCreateHelp: Round tables keep their standard diameter. The chair count follows the selected number of seats.
rectangleTableCreateHelp: Depth stays the same; length follows the seat count. Up to 8 seats, the table is square.
newTableNoSpace: The table with this seat count does not fit in the room. Choose fewer seats or enlarge the room.
duplicateNoSpace: No available position was found for the copy. Move existing tables or enlarge the room, then try again.
seatOccupancyHelp: Filled chairs show actual seat assignments. Guests without a specific chair remain at the table but are not tied to a chair.
seatAssignmentHelp: Choose a guest and assign a chair automatically or manually. Changes are saved after confirmation.
seatArchivedHelp: You can remove an archived person from their table, but cannot assign a new place.
seatCapacityReserved: Seat {number} is assigned. Release it before reducing capacity.
seatOccupiedHelp: This chair is occupied. No one will be moved automatically.
seatNoTables: Add a table before choosing a chair.
seatNoParticipants: Use Add guest here or in the Guests panel to include someone.
seatRangeError: This chair does not exist at the table. Choose a seat within its capacity.
seatOccupiedError: This chair is occupied. Choose a free seat; the previous assignment is preserved.
seatCapacityError: Reducing capacity would remove an occupied chair. Move the guest or release that seat first.
seatShapeError: The table has assigned chairs. Release them before changing its shape.
seatParticipantError: The guest is no longer a participant in this plan. Reload the current layout.
seatTableError: The table is no longer available in this plan. Reload the current layout.
seatNamesZoom: Zoom in for names · tap a chair for details
guestListHelp: Tap a guest to assign or move them.
noGuestResults: No guests match this search and filter.
allGuestsHaveTablesHelp: There are no unassigned guests in this plan.
noPlanGuests: No guests in this plan yet
noPlanGuestsHelp: Add guests from your project or create a new person.
noGuestMatchesHelp: Try another name or add a guest.
tableListHelp: Choose a table from the list or canvas. Moving it keeps the list order.
addGuestToTable: Add a guest to this table
chooseChairOrTableOnly: Choose a specific chair or automatic seating.
includeInPlan: Will be included in the plan
batchOverflow: Short of {count} places. Reduce the selection or increase table capacity.
batchIncludeHelp: Selected guests will be included in the plan. You can choose a table later.
batchLimit: Select up to 100 guests at a time.
batchHelp: Select the guests to add to this table, then confirm.
batchUpgradeRequired: Bulk and automatic seating are not enabled yet. Contact an administrator.
placementAutomaticHelp: Available chairs will be assigned when you save.
placementManualHelp: Choose a specific chair for each guest before saving.
selectedGuestGroup: {count, plural, one {# guest selected} other {# guests selected}}
selectGuestsHelp: Select the guests you want to add.
manualSeatsIncomplete: Choose a chair for each guest.
manualBatchUpgradeRequired: Manual seating of multiple guests is not enabled yet. Contact an administrator.
tableChairListHelp: Available chair: add a guest. Occupied chair: view or move its guest.
manualChairListHelp: Choose an available chair or the guest's current chair. Occupied chairs show who sits there.
chooseTableHelp: Choose a table before assigning a chair.
chooseExactSeats: I want to choose specific chairs
automaticSeatsHelp: Available chairs will be assigned automatically.
exactSeatsHelp: Your selected chairs will be saved.
guestDragTarget: Drag onto a table or chair
publicResponsesHelp: These people are not linked to project guests yet. Add a new person or link an existing one; the original response is preserved.
attendanceSetupRequired: The public guest and manual attendance model needs setup. Existing seating remains available.
